The source request explicitly asks for semantically different constructions and preserves schema and question, but one batched n=2 request cannot establish two independently formulated views. Its empty/nonempty arbitration defect supports source-contract nonconformance, while the frozen scripted responses cannot prove or disprove realized semantic diversity; the semantic question is therefore indeterminate.
